name: Asian Paints Apcolite Premium High Gloss Synthetic Enamel
shortDescription: High-sheen modified alkyd resin enamel paint delivering mirror-like gloss, anti-yellowing protection, and tough washable barrier for architectural metal and wood.
overview: Asian Paints Apcolite Premium Gloss Enamel is India's flagship solvent-based architectural and industrial finish, designed to impart a brilliant mirror-like gloss to exterior and interior metalwork and woodwork. Formulated with high-grade oil-modified long-oil alkyd resins and micro-fine lightfast pigments, it forms a resilient, non-porous protective film that resists moisture, steam, oil stains, and rigorous washings. Its anti-yellowing chemistry preserves crisp white and vivid colors for years, even in humid indoor kitchens or sunlit outdoor railings.
keyFeatures: Mirror-like high gloss finish (exceeding 85 gloss units measured at 60° angle)
Formulated with oil-modified alkyd resin for superior flexibility and impact resistance
Anti-yellowing polymer technology keeps whites and light pastel shades pure over time
Forms an impenetrable, hard protective barrier against water, grime, and daily abrasion
Washable and scrub resistant for effortless maintenance in industrial facilities
High spreading rate provides economical coverage between 100 to 120 sq.ft per litre
Compatible with brush, roller, or conventional air spray application

specifications.Theoretical Coverage: 100 – 120 sq.ft / Litre for 2 Coats (on primed surface)
specifications.Drying Time: Surface Dry: 3 Hours | Hard Recoat: 18 Hours
specifications.Thinner Recommendation: Mineral Turpentine Oil (MTO) or High Quality Thinner (8 – 10% dilution)
specifications.Substrate Suitability: Mild Steel, Wrought Iron, Timber, Masonry, Castings

applications: Architectural metal window grilles, gates, railings, and boundary fences
Industrial machinery frames, switchgear panels, and structural steelwork
Hardwood door frames, timber furniture, and plywood cabinetry
Commercial steel storage lockers, metal staircases, and handrails
